LEARNING-CONTROL-001.success_metric: State schema evolution after R8 does not require incident-specific checker hard-coding while true drift remains fail-closed.

LEARNING-DOCSYS-ACTIVATION-001.success_metric: No reviewed learning is silently treated as active before promotion and lifecycle state cannot remain stale after promotion.
LEARNING-DOCSYS-ACTIVATION-001.measurement_trigger: learning activation or documentation release promotion

LEARNING-SOURCE-VISIBILITY-001.success_metric: Formal handoffs state exact source/package identity plus source addressability and never represent partial/artifact-only visibility as a full mirror.

LEARNING-WORKFLOW-CONTINUITY-001.success_metric: Interrupted/resumed workflows reuse the same RUN_ID and do not repeat completed expensive steps when exact output identity is recoverable.

LEARNING-LIFECYCLE-CONSISTENCY-002.success_metric: Zero lifecycle/register/project-state drift across subsequent sessions; ineffective learning always has a successor/meta-review path; no unreviewed correction auto-promotes.
LEARNING-LIFECYCLE-CONSISTENCY-002.measurement_trigger: first lifecycle inconsistency or after three subsequent canonical state transitions

LEARNING-ADVERSARIAL-FIXTURE-ISOLATION-0.success_metric: The identical adversarial lifecycle regression suite passes before and after promotion while still rejecting partial and mixed-target simulated verdict sets.
LEARNING-ADVERSARIAL-FIXTURE-ISOLATION-0.measurement_trigger: next documentation promotion and after three subsequent canonical state transitions

LEARNING-ADVERSARIAL-STATE-INDEPENDENCE-.success_metric: Adversarial lifecycle fixtures construct their own semantic preconditions and remain valid across subsequent ambient lifecycle states while still forcing the intended checker failure class.
LEARNING-ADVERSARIAL-STATE-INDEPENDENCE-.measurement_trigger: subsequent canonical lifecycle-state changes after V36 activation

LEARNING-PROMOTION-STATE-FINALIZATION-00.success_metric: Completed prior-promotion learning is normalized from transition-only ACTIVE_ON_PROMOTION into durable ACTIVE/PASS before a later promotion contract replaces final-review/final-audit fields.
LEARNING-PROMOTION-STATE-FINALIZATION-00.measurement_trigger: subsequent canonical promotion-state transitions after V37 activation

LEARNING-RECOVERY-STATE-VERSIONING-006.success_metric: Recovery schema changes migrate producers before stricter consumer success is claimed, no recovery check is weakened to accept old-schema payload, and off-host metadata pins stable identity rather than rotating operational state.
LEARNING-RECOVERY-STATE-VERSIONING-006.measurement_trigger: next recovery-schema/off-host-metadata change or two subsequent canonical state transitions
